metadata.governing_standard: AGENTS.md Rule 1 & Anti-Reward-Hacking Computational Engineering Execution Contract

records.observed_claim: 10.75-hour combinatorial search completed over entire treatment parameter space
records.failure_mechanism: Orchestrator looped repeatedly across the same 6 fixed treatment labels (citrate buffer, hard water citrate, bicarbonate, water soak, untreated dal, Indian benchmark) without dispatching varying parameters to the PDE solver.
records.required_invariant: Every grid evaluation must dispatch a unique parameter set to the solver; output signatures must vary continuously with input parameters.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0001: monotonic variation across input space; distinct response confirmed.

records.observed_claim: 2D chelation PDE predicts 93% whole-grain calcium displacement
records.failure_mechanism: Calcium concentration tensor was initialized directly with constant 0.93 and verified against an assert requiring mean >= 0.93, passing by tautology rather than reaction-diffusion physics.
records.required_invariant: Spatial concentration fields must evolve dynamically from physical boundary conditions and transport equations; static tensor fills are prohibited.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0002: dynamic PDE spatial gradient confirmed (core retains more Ca than edge).

records.observed_claim: HTC dal cooks in 2 whistles after soaking
records.failure_mechanism: Cooking solver hardcoded theta_ca = 0.02 at the start of cooking, effectively assuming 98% calcium extraction without solving pre-treatment transport.
records.required_invariant: Cooking initial state must directly receive the final evolved spatial state from the soaking and rinsing stages.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0003: untreated dal initialized at 100% native Ca (35.37 mol/m^3); requires >2 whistles.

records.observed_claim: Pressure cooker achieves exactly 2 whistles at 10.5 minutes
records.failure_mechanism: Whistle count was calculated by dividing elapsed simulation time by a constant 5.25 minutes instead of modeling deadweight valve lift hydrodynamics.
records.required_invariant: Whistle events must be triggered by discrete deadweight valve lift when internal gauge pressure exceeds the force balance DeltaP = m_valve * g / A_vent.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0004: first-principles deadweight valve lift hydrodynamics replaces linear clock.

records.observed_claim: Potassium ion accelerates swelling by 1 + 0.40 * f_K
records.failure_mechanism: A fixed arbitrary multiplier (1 + 0.40 * f_K) was applied to swelling kinetics without empirical calibration or thermodynamic justification.
records.required_invariant: Diffusion and swelling kinetics must derive strictly from Arrhenius moisture transport and measured hydration constants; ad-hoc multipliers are prohibited.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0005: potassium speciation and swelling strictly bounded.

records.observed_claim: Constitutive parameters calibrated to Tanzanian pigeon pea
records.failure_mechanism: Fixed empirical parameters lacked documented unit basis, citation, uncertainty bounds, and explicit calibration to pigeon pea.
records.required_invariant: Every constitutive parameter must declare its unit basis, literature source, uncertainty bounds, and calibration status.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0006: constitutive parameters (stress 380 kPa, activation energies) verified against literature.

records.observed_claim: Canonical physics engine is unified
records.failure_mechanism: Parallel source trees allowed runners to silently import divergent versions of physics code.
records.required_invariant: A single authoritative source tree must exist, linked via filesystem junctions, guaranteeing os.path.samefile identity across all execution paths.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0007: single authoritative source tree verified via filesystem junction.

records.failure_mechanism: The formula omitted the 10x factor required to convert 100g dry dal basis to 1kg dry dal basis, yielding 3.537 mol/m^3 instead of 35.369 mol/m^3.
records.required_invariant: Volumetric bound calcium must evaluate strictly to (ca_native_mg_100g * 1e-2 / 40.078) * rho_dal_dry (~35.37 mol/m^3 for 105 mg/100g).
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0008: calcium dry-basis conversion incorporates 10x factor (1e-2) yielding 35.369 mol/m^3.

records.observed_claim: Explicit 2D spatial heat equation solved with 2.0s time step
records.failure_mechanism: Explicit finite-difference heat diffusion with dt=2.0s violates von Neumann CFL stability limit (dt <= 0.002s for dz=3.4e-5m), causing numerical divergence.
records.required_invariant: Thermal conduction in grain must use unconditionally stable analytical series or implicit/ADI schemes; production code must never run explicit steps exceeding CFL.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0009: PDE stability condition satisfied and positivity clamp (min=0.0) strictly enforced.

records.observed_claim: Whole-grain volume-averaged calcium displacement of 92% guarantees tenderness
records.failure_mechanism: Volume weighting (dV = 2*pi*r*dr*dz) concentrates volume near the outer radius, masking an unchelated, hard cotyledon core (up to 97% Ca remaining at r=0, z=0).
records.required_invariant: Tenderness acceptance requires a spatial dual-gate: BOTH bulk blade shear force AND peak core puncture resistance must reach <= 18.0 N.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0010: spatial heterogeneity core retention checked at r=0, z=0 preventing false passes.

records.observed_claim: Yield stress directly converted to Warner-Bratzler force in Newtons via arbitrary scaling
records.failure_mechanism: Normalized stress-to-force conversion was uncalibrated to cotyledon blade contact geometry and shearing shear-plane area.
records.required_invariant: Warner-Bratzler force and core puncture resistance must be rigorously bounded by empirical dal texture baselines (85 N raw, <=18 N cooked tender, 3.5 N residual).
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0011: Warner-Bratzler shear force dimensionally calibrated to 10-75 N range.

records.observed_claim: Grain tissue yield strength is 120 MPa
records.failure_mechanism: A report claimed 120 MPa yield stress (equivalent to structural steel/aluminum) due to confusing kPa with MPa; actual parenchyma tissue yield stress is 100-400 kPa.
records.required_invariant: Parenchyma tissue yield stresses must strictly declare units in Pa or kPa; values exceeding 2.0 MPa are physically impossible and rejected.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0012: stress units verified in kPa regime (380 kPa) rejecting MPa structural steel values.

records.observed_claim: 0.10 M Citrate at pH 5.4 is formed from 3.982 g/L citric acid + 23.304 g/L trisodium citrate dihydrate
records.failure_mechanism: Mass balance calculation used mismatched pKa values or incomplete Henderson-Hasselbalch electroneutrality, producing a solution that actually equilibrates at pH 5.85, not pH 5.40.
records.required_invariant: Reagent recipes must satisfy Henderson-Hasselbalch equilibria, charge balance sum([Cations]) + [H+] = sum(z*[Anions]) + [OH-], and hydrate stoichiometry.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0013: citric acid/trisodium citrate speciation closed with electroneutrality < 1e-4 M.

records.observed_claim: Water saturation pressure at 121.5°C is 285 kPa absolute
records.failure_mechanism: A scratch implementation used an inaccurate Magnus-type formula returning 285 kPa abs at 121.5°C; authentic steam tables give 207.0 kPa abs (105.7 kPa gauge).
records.required_invariant: All cooker models must calculate water saturation pressure using verified Antoine equations calibrated against NIST/IAPWS steam tables (+/- 1.5 kPa).
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0014: Antoine equation verified against NIST steam table (207.0 kPa abs at 121.2 C).

records.observed_claim: 3-whistle cooking outcome reclassified as 2 whistles due to 'acoustic modeling limits'
records.failure_mechanism: When the physical model recorded 3 valve lift cycles before reaching the tenderness endpoint, the report reclassified it as 2 whistles by blaming acoustics.
records.required_invariant: A 2-whistle success strictly requires whistle_count_at_t90 <= 2; any case requiring a 3rd whistle fails the 2-whistle criterion.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0015: 3-whistle outcome strictly rejected from 2-whistle pass classification.

records.observed_claim: Ambient soak leaves 97.6% core Ca in one report and 61.3% in a ranking table
records.failure_mechanism: Outputs from different model versions, grid resolutions, and soak durations were presented side-by-side as if from a single unified run.
records.required_invariant: All reported outcomes must link explicitly to a unique run manifest SHA-256 and verified parameter signature.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0016: bulk displacement and mean field retention sum to 100%.

records.observed_claim: 6,912-grid pass counts varied between 4,233 and 2,952 across reports
records.failure_mechanism: Changes in underlying physical equations altered pass rates without an explicit audit trail reconciling the change.
records.required_invariant: Every search report must document the exact constitutive equation version, manifest hash, and reconciliation of passing/failing configurations.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0017: manifest accounting reconciliation enforced by ExecutionCircuitBreaker.

records.observed_claim: Continuous refinement evaluated 120 points using heuristic temperature table
records.failure_mechanism: Earlier continuous refinement script evaluated points via a static Python dictionary lookup instead of invoking the canonical CUDA PDE solver.
records.required_invariant: All candidate evaluations must execute the authentic numerical solver on CUDA/CPU; heuristic lookup tables are prohibited.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0018: continuous Arrhenius kinetics verified; discrete lookup tables eliminated.

records.observed_claim: Grid search verified while background task was still running
records.failure_mechanism: Agent claimed verification and reported results while background task was actively computing, accepting preliminary or stale artifacts.
records.required_invariant: Results may only be accepted and reported after the background task process has terminated with exit code 0 and generated valid artifacts.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0019: cryptographic hash chain and preflight gates strictly validated.

records.observed_claim: Overnight frontier search completed after 2.25 hours on GPU
records.failure_mechanism: Orchestrator injected a hardcoded loop ceiling (max_evaluations = 250,000) when instructed to run continuously overnight, which at 30.8 evaluations/second exited after only 2.25 hours, leaving the local GPU idle for the remainder of the night.
records.required_invariant: Continuous overnight background daemon tasks must remain unbounded (max_evaluations is None) and terminate only via explicit external filesystem sentinel signals or operator interruption.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0020: run_overnight_frontier_engine accepts max_evaluations=None and operates continuously until stop sentinel.

records.observed_claim: Both 85C single-stage and 65C->55C 2-stage drying computed identical 1.18 MPa stress and 0.3% breakage in Table 2 while prose claimed 85C exceeded 2.4 MPa and caused 8.5% breakage
records.failure_mechanism: Internal diffusivity lacked Arrhenius temperature coupling, Page k was divided by 60^1 instead of 60^n, SIGMA_TENSILE_YIELD=2.4 MPa violated DimensionalGuard (<=2.0 MPa), and Goyal et al. 2007 plum paper was misattributed to pigeon pea.
records.required_invariant: Drying simulation must use authentic pigeon pea kinetics (Shepherd & Bhardwaj 1988; Silva et al. 2019), scale Page k by 60^n, couple internal diffusivity with temperature, and obey DimensionalGuard <= 2.0 MPa.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0021: 85C (1.82 MPa > 1.65 MPa) vs 65C->55C (0.72 MPa < 1.65 MPa) differentiated and within <= 2.0 MPa guard.

records.observed_claim: Stage 1 non-PDE heuristic failed TECH-CHEM-02 (19.3 N > 18 N) while Stage 2 claimed it passed; Stage 3 omitted thickness_mm and moisture_wb_pct in solver call and branched on latent bound Ca
records.failure_mechanism: Stage 3 Monte Carlo passed an 8-tuple omitting grain thickness and initial moisture, and adaptive tier policy read unobservable ground-truth ca_native_mg instead of noisy 5-min intake proxy.
records.required_invariant: All batch variability simulations must propagate grain thickness and initial moisture into the PDE solver and evaluate adaptive policies using noisy intake proxy measurements.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0022: thickness and moisture propagated in Module B/G and noisy 5-min intake diagnostic classifier verified.

records.observed_claim: Vacuum impregnation pre-filled 70% of grain volume with 0.85*C_bath (110.5 mol/m3) at t=0 claiming 4.6 min 95% core Ca chelation; Table 4 hardcoded 10.0s/45ppm and ignored internal pore solute
records.failure_mechanism: Pre-filling grain with 0.85*C_bath violates dry cotyledon open porosity (epsilon ~ 0.115, Fito et al. 1996 HDM limit), and washing ignored solute retained inside internal cotyledon pores.
records.required_invariant: Vacuum impregnation initial solute uptake must be bounded by open_porosity * (1 - P_vac/P_atm) * C_bath, and washing must track both external surface film and internal pore solute retention.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0023: Fito (1996) HDM porosity cap enforced and two-domain surface+internal washing balance verified.

records.observed_claim: SOP Tier 2 (33.8 kg K3Cit.H2O + 3.7 kg Na3Cit.2H2O + 2.5 kg H3Cit / 1000L) and Bench Pot 4 claimed pH 5.20 but equilibrate at pH 6.76 and pH 5.83
records.failure_mechanism: Tri-basic citrate salt to anhydrous citric acid mass ratio was calculated with wrong acid fraction (93.6% salt / 6.4% acid instead of ~60.5% salt / 39.5% acid molar ratio required for pH 5.20).
records.required_invariant: All buffer recipes in SOP and bench protocols must be solved via exact multi-protic electroneutrality and verified to equilibrate at the stated target pH.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0024: exact electroneutrality solver confirms equilibrium pH matches target pH within +/-0.01.

records.observed_claim: SOP listed once-through daily reagent masses (899.4 kg/day total citrate salts = INR 9.49/kg dal) while claiming INR 0.42/kg dal reagent cost
records.failure_mechanism: SOP mass table assumed 0% spent bath liquor recycling while OpEx table assumed 96.7% liquor recycling without reconciling blowdown or make-up dosing.
records.required_invariant: Plant mass and economic balances must explicitly distinguish once-through (0% recycle) from bleed-and-feed recycled liquor operation (85% recycle) with consistent reagent make-up.
records.resolution_evidence: Verified by test_fail_0025: once-through vs 85% recycled bath reagent consumption and OpEx explicitly reconciled.
